# A window closed and kept a while for Undo (undo-timeout) takes no queued
# prompt: its sessions end when that's over. Brought back, its queue goes on.
action:close_window
wait:0.5
queue-prompt:echo UNDO-$((6*7))
wait:1.5
expect-queue:1
expect-not:UNDO-42
undo:go
wait:2.0
expect:UNDO-42
expect-queue:0
